# MDL304 · `semicolon-comment`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A line starting with `;` is a key, not a comment.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | error |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | K3, F6 |

## Why

MySQL option files accept `;` comments; GLib does not. `; nightly dump` is a key (mydumper's pre-processor gives it the value 1): in [mydumper] it is an unknown option, fatal at startup up to v1.0.0-1. Replacing `;` with `#` turns it into the comment it was meant to be. The fix is safe when the key has no effect today (an unknown option that the version ignores, a group nobody reads), unsafe otherwise.

## Example

With mydumper v1.0.5-1:

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
  ; nightly dump
threads=4
[other]
; note
```

```text
2:3-2:4 error MDL304[semicolon-comment] `;` does not start a comment for GLib: this line is a key
  = mydumper passes it as an unknown option, which this version ignores.
  fix (safe): Replace `;` with `#`
5:1-5:2 error MDL304[semicolon-comment] `;` does not start a comment for GLib: this line is a key
  = The line is a key of a group nobody reads: harmless, but not a comment.
  fix (safe): Replace `;` with `#`
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
  # nightly dump
threads=4
[other]
# note
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL304: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL304` on the line above it.
